title: NASA electrostatics lab measures thrust in high vacuum

tellings.quote: We've been doing that since 2020. So, for the last 6 years, we test almost every day, probably every other day.

plain: A NASA electrostatics lab at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida has been measuring thrust, a push, produced by electric charge in a high vacuum, testing almost every day or every other day since 2020. Charles Buhler, a scientist who works on the tests, tells Michels this himself, and links the work to Thomas Townsend Brown, an earlier inventor of electric propulsion ideas. If true, it would suggest a way to move craft without burning fuel.
